steps.fingerNumbers: Your fingers have numbers: the thumb is 1, then 2 for the index finger, 3 for the middle finger, 4 for the ring finger and 5 for the little finger. Both hands use the same numbers.
steps.position: Place your right thumb on middle {c}, and each finger on the next white key: 1 on {c}, 2 on {d}, 3 on {e}, 4 on {f} and 5 on {g}. Keep your fingers curved, as if holding a ball.
steps.up: Play up, one finger at a time, from 1 to 5.
steps.down: Now play back down, from 5 to 1.
steps.withMetronome: Now with the metronome: up and back down, one note per click.
